description: This file defines the internal sealed class SerializationCallbacksFactory in the Orleans.Serialization namespace, responsible for creating and caching delegates for serialization callbacks (methods marked with serialization attributes such as OnSerializing, OnSerialized, etc.). It uses reflection and dynamic method generation to invoke these methods during serialization/deserialization processes.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacksFactory
classes.description: Creates and caches delegates for serialization callback methods identified by attributes, supporting both reference and value types with dynamic method invocation.

classes.name: SerializationCallbacksFactory.SerializationCallbacks<TDelegate>
classes.description: Holds delegates for serialization callback methods (OnDeserializing, OnDeserialized, OnSerializing, OnSerialized) for a specific delegate type.

methods.name: GetReferenceTypeCallbacks
methods.description: Returns serialization callbacks for a reference type, utilizing caching.

methods.name: GetValueTypeCallbacks
methods.description: Returns serialization callbacks for a value type, with generic parameters for owner type and delegate type.

methods.name: GetValueTypeCallbacks (private)
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create callbacks for a value type given the type and owner type.

methods.name: CreateTypedCallbacks
methods.description: Creates serialization callbacks by inspecting methods on a type and identifying callback methods based on attributes, generating delegates accordingly.

methods.name: GetSerializationMethod
methods.description: Generates a DynamicMethod that, when invoked, calls the appropriate serialization callback method using IL emission.
